name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Redesigns patch intensity so weak/normal/strong use the same champion and item volume, differing only by final numeric change range.
notes: Weak now clamps generated numeric changes to 90%..110%, normal to 85%..115%, and strong to 80%..120%.
Selected champion count and per-champion item count are kept at the strong-baseline volume for every intensity.
A duplicate champion.field merge patch keeps the first generated item, preventing same-event compounding such as 100 -> 120 -> 144.
The fix is applied inside the EXE generation/merge path so the in-game patch note and actual champion data stay aligned.
